content: <thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 183.045 Da. In positive mode this is most plausibly the [M+H]⁺ ion, giving a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈182.038 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1) indicates about nine carbon atoms. The formula that best matches this mass and carbon count is C₉H₁₀O₄ (exact mass 182.0579 Da, within typical high‑resolution error). Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C9H10O4.
